title: Social Security Is About to Get CUT… And Nobody Is Ready
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: Retirement trust fund runs dry in late 2032 and benefits automatically drop to about 78 cents on the dollar; Congress likely kicks the can.
Washington will most likely print to pay the IOUs, making cash worth less, so people should build their own nest egg.

notes: Commentary on Social Security; no market or ticker calls made.
